mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production below 108 and housing starts below 1250 thousand units indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both INDPRO and HOUST are below thresholds, or interaction effect Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in retail sales below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS is below 12-month MA during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 110 for two consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has been above 110 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1200 thousand units in a month, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is below 1200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime, a decline in non-farm payrolls below 100 thousand new jobs signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is below 100 during low-unemployment regimes, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.
